content: Kunal Mehta inquired about starting a new health plan after his old one expired and asked about reducing the standard 30-day waiting period. Ravi Menon explained that individual plans have a fixed 30-day waiting period unless covered by an employer group plan. Additionally, Kunal requested and received his claim-history summary and the latest health-plan brochure, and stated he would review them and follow up.

action_items: Kunal Mehta to review the claim-history summary and the new health plan brochure
